text: In the landmark Shen et al. (2017) MIT experiment, what vowel-classification accuracy did the on-chip photonic neural network reach compared with the digital baseline?
choices: 76.7% photonic vs 91.7% digital, using 56 thermo-optic MZIs
explanation: Shen et al. (2017) used 56 thermo-optic MZIs implementing SVD-programmed 4x4 layers and reached 76.7% accuracy versus 91.7% for digital, a roughly 15-point gap attributed to phase-encoding error and detection noise. Option 1 reverses the two numbers; the photonic result neither matched digital (option 2) nor collapsed to chance (option 3).
